verification.mandatory_sequence_respected: curation commit -> freeze commit -> capture commit -> primaries -> seal -> grades -> seal -> adjudications -> seal -> adjudication grades -> seal -> decision; no rater, grader or adjudicator ran before the capture commit
verification.prompt_binding: every committed prompt rebuilds from its pre-registered bundle and follow-up read (checked at seal and decide)

execution_audit.operator_of_stages_3_to_7: root orchestration agent (the candidate's author) through content-free scripts; see operator-attestation.json
execution_audit.limitation: Operator separation is weaker than in the second holdout: the sandboxed Codex operator could not commit or create worktrees, so the candidate's author executed the remaining phases mechanically. Blindness rests on the per-item discipline and on scripts that never print content; no separate person witnessed it.

model_reproducibility_limitation: OpenAI exposes no immutable backend snapshot or build digest for gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.6-sol; rater, grader and adjudicator behaviour is not byte-reproducible and is recorded as such.
